title: family_notify_set
description: Switch the automatic child notifications of this device on or off (only kinds with can_disable; kids_release_requested stays on). Goes to this device in the app; the admin decides about Home Assistant notify targets. Family manager devices only (effective rule family_manager); otherwise family_error {not_permitted}. Also accepted through the integration relay (POST /api/integration/family) when the device is away. Answer: family_notify.
